description:
MindPulse: Global mental health intelligence API. Evidence-based guidance on therapy platform matching, mental health assessment, burnout, psychiatric medication context, coping techniques, sleep disorders (CBT-

Coverage: Global

Endpoints:
  • match ($0.10): Therapy platform matching
  • assessment ($0.10): Mental health self-assessment
  • burnout ($0.10): Burnout assessment and recovery protocol
  • medication ($0.10): Psychiatric medication context
  • technique ($0.08): Evidence-based coping technique guide
  • sleep ($0.08): Sleep disorder guidance (CBT-I protocol)
  • grief ($0.08): Grief and loss support
  • relationship ($0.10): Relationship and communication guidance
  • workplace ($0.08): Workplace mental health guidance
  • crisis (FREE): Crisis resource routing — ALWAYS FREE
  • postpartum ($0.10): Postpartum and perinatal mental health guidance
  • addiction ($0.10): Addiction support and harm-reduction guidance

action.description: Which endpoint to call. Options: match | assessment | burnout | medication | technique | sleep | grief | relationship | workplace | crisis | postpartum | addiction

approach_preference.description: Preferred approach type (CBT, DBT, ACT, mindfulness, somatic)

concern.description: Mental health concern to address (e.g., panic+attacks, rumination, anger)

country.description: User's country for localized crisis resources

drug.description: Medication name (generic or brand — e.g., sertraline, Zoloft, quetiapine)

duration.description: How long symptoms have been present (e.g., 3+months)

jurisdiction.description: Country/jurisdiction for legal framework (US, UK, CA, AU)

lang.description: Response language (e.g., es, fr, de, ja)

modality.description: Preferred therapy modality (CBT, DBT, ACT, coaching)

relationship_type.description: Type of relationship (romantic, family, friendship, work)

stage.description: Stage: curious, cutting-back, quitting, relapse, supporting-someone

substance-or-behavior.description: Substance or behavior (e.g. alcohol, opioids, stimulants, gambling, gaming, nicotine, benzodiazepines)

type.description: Type of loss (spousal, parent, child, pet, relationship, identity, health)

name: mindpulse
